typeHelp.text: Text with a configurable character limit, for example a title or notes.
typeHelp.number: A whole or decimal number, for example a quantity or price.
typeHelp.boolean: A yes or no value, for example whether something has been checked or completed.
typeHelp.date: A calendar date without a time, for example a purchase date.
typeHelp.time: A time of day without a date, for example 14:30.
typeHelp.datetime: A calendar date with a time, for example an appointment.
typeHelp.duration: An elapsed amount of time, for example usage time.
typeHelp.select: One option can be selected for each item.
typeHelp.multiselect: Multiple options can be selected for each item.
typeHelp.id: An automatically assigned, read-only number for each item.
typeHelp.url: A web address with optional link text.
typeHelp.checkbox: A checkbox that can be toggled directly in the table.

settings.title: Field settings
settings.requiredHelp: Required for new items and when saving an existing item. Existing items stay unchanged until edited.
settings.sortableHelp: Allow sorting the item table by this field's values.
settings.automaticIdHelp: Numbering starts at 1. Existing items also receive a number when the field is saved.
settings.reuseDeletedIdsHelp: Reassigns the smallest available number. Old references may then point to a different item.
